name: youtube-transcript
description: YouTube captions via the official Data API: list a video's caption tracks and download one as timed segments and plain text (videos you can edit), or parse VTT/SRT you already have

nodes.title: List caption tracks
nodes.description: Lists a video's caption tracks (id, language, name, standard or auto-generated, draft, status) with the official YouTube Data API (OAuth; 50 quota units)

video.description: Video id (11 characters) or a youtube.com / youtu.be URL

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get a transcript
nodes.description: Downloads a caption track with the official YouTube Data API (captions.download, OAuth, 200 quota units; only for videos the authorised account can edit) and returns timed segments and plain text, or the raw file

video.description: Video id (11 characters) or a youtube.com / youtu.be URL; required unless caption_id is given

language.description: Track language, e.g. en (default: the best published track); standard tracks are preferred over auto-generated ones

caption_id.description: A track id from list_caption_tracks; skips the listing (`video` is then not needed and the result's video_id is null, since the track's video is not checked)

translate_to.description: Language code for a machine translation by YouTube (tlang)

format.description: segments: parsed segments and text; otherwise the caption file as returned

max_chars.description: Longest transcript text; longer text is cut and `truncated` is true (segments are cut to match)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Parse a caption file
nodes.description: Parses WebVTT or SRT caption text you already have into timed segments and plain transcript text (no network, no credentials)

content.description: WebVTT or SRT file contents (at most YOUTUBE_TRANSCRIPT_MAX_CAPTION_BYTES, default 5 MiB)

max_chars.description: Longest transcript text; longer text is cut and `truncated` is true (segments are cut to match)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
